result:
My QA verdict on the frozen DG5 candidate is **PASS**, with one new Low finding (F-DG5-140) that I don't consider blocking. The candidate is `sha256:ff3bc2c4…1008` (2203 files, source `2fe8f85`). Its ID matched on a complete clone and in the working tree at the start and the end of the review. All 78 DG5 requirements are verified with evidence from this run.

**What ran, all on this candidate:**
- **Static checks:** all 7 passed. The OpenAPI contract has 846 operations.
- **Unit tests:** `pnpm test` passed on Node 22 and Node 24, with the locale unset and with C.UTF-8 (2350 / 1746 / 259 tests, plus 2 skips by design).
- **Integration:** run twice on a throwaway database. Both passed (320 files, 3084 tests, 1 skip by design). Migrations run 0001→0097; the 8 unused numbers are documented as retired. All `p5-pending` lists are empty.
- **`tests/qa` on its own:** 336/336 integration and 22/22 unit.
- **REQ-DLV-037:** A06 27, A07 12, A15 34 and A16 30 tests pass. I inspected 62 exported PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPTX files in English and Arabic. Each has the right text direction, the B0004 provenance statement in its language, no "official PMI" or certification claim, and no DG0–DG7 names.
- **Product e2e:** 470/470 with C.UTF-8.
  - With the locale unset, 455 passed and 5 failed. Four were 30-second timeouts at very high machine load with no failed assertion. The fifth was a sign-in miss while the shared disk was full; that cause is not proven.
  - The five spec files re-run alone passed 70/70. I recorded these as observations, not defects.
- **Root acceptance specs:** 30/30 in both locale settings. Demo-stack specs: 12/12 in both.
- **Validators:** `--register DG5`, `--pipeline`, and `--historical` for DG4, DG3, DG2 and DG1 all pass.

**My own probes**, kept outside the candidate in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG5/qa/tests/round-1/`. They target the clauses the register says are only partly covered:
- **Auditor pass:** 42 P5 screens × 2 languages, 84/84 in both settings. No write requests, no enabled write controls, no serious axe issues, and no overflow at 390 px or 200% text.
- **REQ-PB-093, through the Studio screens in en and ar:**
  - Publishing defaults that total 95% is refused.
  - After 30/20/20/15/15 is published, a new transformation starts with it; an existing one keeps 25/25/20/15/15.
- **Demo checks:**
  - The REQ-PB-090 chain shows in order on the rendered traceability view.
  - The synthetic approval label appears on an approval opened from the inbox.
  - The Day-90 screen shows the six questions verbatim and is incomplete while unanswered.
  - The demo banner appears on 29 P5 screens.
- **REQ-S13-008:** a generated executive pack prints the pending SAR 99,000 value as "Provisional" / "مؤقت".
- **Other clauses:**
  - All twelve extension record types have create and read operations, so the contract test exercises each one.
  - My independent NPV calculation matches the expected −21.04 and −19.12.

Several probe attempts failed because of mistakes in my own probes, not product defects. Each one is kept, labelled, and explained in `RUN-NOTES.md`.

**Finding:**
- **F-DG5-140 (Low, not mandatory; owner backend-workflow-engineer; requirement REQ-S01-002).**
  - **What happens:** before any branding is saved, every Arabic PDF, DOCX and PPTX export prints the English product name "Mobily Transformation Hub" in its header. ADR-0049 §8, the API and the Arabic shell all use "منصة موبايلي للتحوّل" in that state.
  - **Cause:** `apps/worker/src/reports/export-runner.ts:379-381` falls back to the English-only `DEFAULTS.productName`.
  - **Effect:** none on acceptance; REQ-S01-002's literal acceptance text still holds.
  - **ID collision:** the earlier re-gate branch also used F-DG5-140 (closed there). The assignment requires my range in order, so I used it; this needs the orchestrator's attention.

**Observations, not findings:**
- The traceability view shows extra deliverable and capability nodes between the initiative and the KPI.
- A generated weight-set rationale shows in English on the Arabic screen.
- Some unit tests print error-boundary noise from incomplete mock data, though they still assert their clause.

**Environment:** the four environmental residuals are recorded as PASS on the offline/configuration surface: live registry, live CI, a real demo IdP, and the AI/notification adapters. The shared disk filled up once during the run. I freed about 4 GB from my own copy, and all clones and scratch are now removed.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- `reviews/DG5/round-1/qa-verifier.json`
- `reviews/DG5/round-1/qa-verifier.findings.json`
- `reviews/DG5/round-1/qa-verifier.md`
- `test-evidence/DG5/qa/round-1/RUN-NOTES.md`
- `test-evidence/DG5/qa/round-1/15-requirements-matrix.md`
